seriesTitle: Elite Short Stories: Phillipe Caye Felipe

episodes.title: Parte 1
episodes.summary: While donating clothes with Rebe, Cayetana meets a new friend and volunteers her sewing services for Christmas.

episodes.title: Parte 2
episodes.summary: Phillipe's generous donation catches Cayetana off guard and she asks Felipe to do her a favor in exchange for dinner.

episodes.title: Parte 3
episodes.summary: Cayetana faces off with her ex, who shares his feelings and asks her to consider whether forgiveness is an option.
